$why: Decides whether a confirmed finding warrants an addendum to an agent profile. The role to
target is supplied explicitly -- "target THIS profile, not a guess from the gate name" --
because the gate that reported a finding is not the agent that caused it, and augmenting
the wrong profile teaches the wrong agent.
description: Judges whether a confirmed finding is a novel pattern worth appending to an agent profile.
body:
__PROFILE__

## Finding to evaluate
```json
__FINDING_JSON__
```

Profiles file: __PROFILES_FILE__
Story that wrote the offending code: __STORY_ID__
That story's agentRole (target THIS profile, not a guess from the gate name): __STORY_AGENT_ROLE__

Check if the pattern is novel and append a rule if needed. Write the updated profiles.json back, then emit the JSON summary.
